title: Relative Tor amplitude bounds pulled-back tensor
statement: For any morphism f:X -> S and E in D(O_X) with finite Tor dimension over f-inverse O_S, there is an integer a such that E tensor^L Lf*(F[0]) has zero cohomology below a for every O_S-module F, without any quasi-coherence or geometric assumptions.

source.place: Tag 08EV, proof, second displayed equality and assumption (3); Cohomology Lemma 20.27.4

proof.text: Unpack HasFiniteTorDimensionOver into K, eK, P, K-flatness, q and its quasi-isomorphism, and a finite interval [a,b] bounding P tensor G[0] for every inverse-image-ring module G. Choose a before introducing F.

For F on S and i<a, apply the interval hypothesis to f-inverse F and the disjunction i<a or b<i. The homology-comparison isomorphism identifies the underlying abelian sheaf of the desired derived-tensor homology with that of this zero homology. The functor to abelian sheaves preserves zero objects and is faithful, so the desired homology is zero. DerivedCategory.isGE_iff gives the bound.

theorem exists_relativeTor_pullback_tensor_lower_bound
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hTor : HasFiniteTorDimensionOver f E) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace),
      (E ⊗ (derivedPullback f).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)).IsGE a
